body: Declined without consuming an immutable review: chief blocked exact 8a11088 before registration. Confirmed defects are (1) public human/fixture factories plus fromWire still promote arbitrary nonempty bytes through a self-signed evidence checksum rather than an admitted typed witness, and (2) unframed ReportInputIdentity payload coordinates collide, including (id a:b, schema c) versus (id a, schema b:c). I will await the narrow successor.
